contracts.claim: Runtime output retains its invocation/runtime origin, exact content and counts; content hashes make repeat handback idempotent while new resumed output remains carryable. Empty output has no invented completion.
Handed-back transcript messages retain content/text and origin; user/operator messages are authored by You, other messages by their originating runtime.
Only supported wrappers with nonempty commands produce specs; exact command, cwd, timeout and sorted environment key names survive without serializing environment values.
Wrapper observations retain their runtime/cwd, observed processes, masked environment status, positive TTL and nonnegative heartbeat age; actual file tails stay bounded.
Phase events retain the wrapper's runtime/cwd/log path and the supplied mission/run/phase/status/message association.
Execution receipts project the exact wrapper command, changed files, bounded observed logs, process tree, masked environment, heartbeat age and TTL.
File-backed replay admits only real dictionary rows, skips missing/malformed inputs, respects the event bound and derives latest status from observed receipt/event rows.
Profile selection resolves an explicit existing name first, first matching workspace rule second and registered default last, preserving the selected profile's agent policy.
Skill tools retain name, description, schema and strictness; enabled code execution retains auto memory/file configuration or selected container identity.
Wire serialization preserves model, user input, tools, storage policy and requested continuation/instructions/tool-choice; unset optional fields are omitted.
A lineage timeline consists only of real source JSONL dictionaries, in lineage/source order, tagged with the originating session; missing/malformed rows do not invent events.
Explicit workspace and configured environment roots, project name and Windows mirror survive PlatformConfig construction; this projection performs no NAS activity.
Path candidates are unique; a configured remote project path includes its corresponding local workspace and configured mirror path.
Explicit POSIX coercion maps an embedded Windows drive path to its /mnt drive mount and preserves the remaining path, including through the supervisor's pure helper.
Cache compatibility separates implemented features, configured peers and hash-admitted available sidecar transport; declared transport versions and public discovery policy are projected honestly.
Bootstrap observes exact local object/byte/pin counts and transport readiness without allocating an index or claiming a missing transport is ready.
Import plans are workspace-scoped, BLAKE3/hash bound, preserve current source metadata and kind/pin intent, and state that local import needs no network or publication.

An unapproved local import performs no admission; approved receipts retain plan/content/source identity and pin/kind, honestly distinguish copy from deduplication and claim only locally verified bytes. Source or plan drift fails closed.
Local context reads are bounded, retain digest/offset and match actual admitted bytes and truncation; invalid hash/range or changed admitted content fails closed before context is returned.
Runtime semantic/date versions compare numeric token tuples; v prefixes do not change version identity.
The pure Go environment merge retains unrelated provider entries, emits exactly one safely quoted current OPENCODE_API_KEY export and rejects an empty credential value.
The pure receipt redactor removes the supplied secret and returns at most 8000 characters; proof fixtures use in-memory scratch strings only.
Public service classes stay lazy until requested, then retain their backwards-compatible public class identity; package import alone does not load the autonomous engine.
The four required context/planner/executor/verifier lanes keep their role order and the selected runtime alias normalizes to the owning runtime without launch or route substitution.
Repeated flags and comma lists produce exactly the first-seen nonempty usernames once, preserving order.
Normalized host identities are unique and partition exactly into DNS names and valid IP addresses; a trailing DNS dot does not duplicate a host.
The TLS backend command plan retains its explicit port, public URL and certificate/key paths; verification never launches that command or reads those files.
Supported CPU names resolve to packaged Node architecture and the planned HTTPS archive URL preserves version/architecture; unsupported CPU or empty version stops before download.
Bridge copy completion matches actual destination SHA-256 and source size; deduplication reuses all bytes and partial resume transfers exactly the remainder.
Each sent message's inbox/outbox envelopes exactly match its returned message and attachment metadata; transfer/reuse totals derive only from attachment receipts.
Received materialized attachments stay under the selected output root, match actual SHA-256 and retain file names; optional acknowledgements retain message identity and inbox count stays bounded.
Completed file copies match destination size and SHA-256, preserve exact remaining-byte resume accounting; unchanged-metadata skips do no transfer/hash work.

Directory transfer receipts account for filtered/changed/skipped files and hash-check every actually transferred destination; explicit include-all is retained and unchanged metadata does not fabricate verification work.

A completed transfer returns the identical JSON receipt durably persisted at its selected sender and mirror protocol roots; destination escape, unavailable explicit root and invalid batch sources stop before successful receipt/copy.
Durable queue schema, ordered unique provider identities, canonical lifecycle and public flow metadata remain valid on every load; malformed/future state fails closed without overwrite.
Successful queue writes reread the exact payload through the existing anchored provider-state directory; no credential file is part of this proof.
Queue mutations preserve durable queue/provider operation identities, settle supplied presence observations, expose lost evidence as blocked, and keep cancelled/skipped operations terminal.
Only public flow receipt fields persist; sessionless observers preserve the owning session and conflicting sessions cannot overwrite its durable evidence.
Public queue views retain lifecycle and policy, hide opaque startup ownership, declare no stored secret material and keep Anthropic on its official provider route.

Existing workspace locks and canonical bounded durable leases reserve one startup owner; waiting pollers receive no executable action, stale owners cannot publish, and completion leaves the next startup unclaimed until a real poller.

Inside the existing SQLite lease transaction, closed routes admit work, open cooldowns deny, and half-open routes reserve exactly one live canary keyed by host/runtime/provider. Direct lease creation rechecks the same admission rule.

Observed result metadata opens only its route, respects transient thresholds and preserves stronger auth/credit cooldown against late results; successful owned canaries close/reset and failed/inconclusive canaries reopen durably.

Provider result classification keeps route identity and only bounded category evidence, separates auth/credit/rate/overload/transport, and explicit process success wins over authentication words in output.
Manual circuit reset redacts bounded actor/reason evidence and asks for one future half-open canary rather than bypassing observed failure.
Provider result publication requires the current active lease, matching job and reporting host; mismatched reporting does not update a provider circuit.

Workers record provider failure before durable job completion and doctor exposes every open/half-open route. Explicit trusted local capability observations/environment keep scratch runs within their owned root; they do not prove provider authentication or permit external workspace mappings.
